scientific_integrity: All general Krylov-space and graph-spectral antecedents are credited. The evaluated prime-side rank dichotomy is supplied with an analytical proof and finite reproducibility checks. Publication priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Finite open Cartesian products of paths with odd-prime shifted lengths and uniform hopping; one positive corner absorber. No conclusion for composite shifted lengths, multiple sinks, nonuniform hopping, or finite-time rates.
title: Prime-side rigidity of corner capture on open quantum grids
